collection.title: Porsche Boxster 2004 to 2012 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Porsche Boxster 2004 to 2012 (987) will fit, this model requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 21" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
